summary_en: 150,000 shares (1.0% of S/O) to be acquired via ToSTNeT-3 off-market block trade on 2026-08-12 at ¥1,060/share (today's close), ¥159.0M upper limit.
title_en: Notice Regarding Acquisition of Treasury Stock and Purchase of Treasury Stock via Off-Market Trade Transaction (ToSTNeT-3)
translation_en_brief: On 10 August 2026, OHKI Healthcare Holdings' board resolved to acquire up to 150,000 treasury shares (1.0% of shares outstanding excluding treasury) via a single off-market block trade using the ToSTNeT-3 mechanism on the Tokyo Stock Exchange. The purchase is set for 12 August 2026 at the market opening slot (08:45 JST) at ¥1,060 per share (today's closing price, inclusive of special quotation), with an aggregate ceiling of ¥159.0M. The company stated the acquisition supports agile capital policy in response to changing business conditions. Results will be announced after trading on 12 August. As of 31 July 2026, the company held 430,876 treasury shares against 13,641,224 shares outstanding excluding treasury.
